title: UAP project document (one file under projects/ holds the Tasks of one project)
description: Project files hold project-related work: each Task (Work Item) belongs to this project and references one or more independent IPs by their Id. The project itself is described by the document root (Id/Name), so Tasks carry no Project field.

Id.description: Slug identifier; must match the file name under projects/ and an entry in cfg/projects.json.

TaskId.description: Identifier of this task, unique within the project file (and conventionally prefixed with the project id).

IPs.description: References to IP Ids (documents under ips/); one or more.

Partners.description: Organizations working on this task (references into cfg/partners.json, matched by name or alias). At least one required.

ForkURL.description: Fork or branch URL for this task's work, if it differs from the IP canonical URL.
